reason: Conversation 1 asked a sensible clarifying question first, correctly identified the intermittent tumbling after 'End' as a normal anti-crease/cool-down phase by its second turn, and confirmed it as normal when told it lasts an hour and stops on door opening, with no unsupported fault claims (its only weakness was an irrelevant 'not heating' image and an initial 10-20 minute guess it then corrected). Conversation 2 opened by speculating about a control fault or stuck relay, then muddled the picture with electronic-fault, child-lock and delay-start theories, wasting a turn on a lock-light check before finally landing on anti-crease. It also closed with the false claim that the feature 'cannot be permanently disabled without specialist service', when most Beko dryers let the user switch anti-crease off via the panel or manual.
